# THE WINDOWS TEST SHARDS (U-ci-shards, U-ci-shards-3) — the partition, here and nowhere else. Read only by
# .github/ci/shard-filter.sh: the workflow makes one windows test job per shard, and each runs the whole
# solution outside the Timing category under that shard's filter.
#
# "shards N" says how many. Every other line is "<shard> <prefix>": every class whose full name starts with the
# prefix runs in that shard, and the LONGEST matching prefix wins (so a two-letter line moves part of a one-letter
# line's classes elsewhere). A class no prefix matches runs in shard N, the last, so no test is ever left out; and
# a new class goes where its first letters already send its neighbours, so the shards stay balanced as classes are
# added. A prefix on two lines (in any case) is refused; a prefix that matched no class in its shard is a ::warning
# on the run, and so is a last shard whose unrouted classes pass a tenth of all of them. Prefixes are
# TradeAgent.Tests.<Segment>.<letters>; the test namespaces are flat, and `check` refuses a class that is not.
#
# BALANCED ON THE MEAN PER-CLASS DURATIONS OF SIX WINDOWS RUNS, from their trx files: 43380925451, 43380260747,
# 43379365239, 43373427465, 43372647269 and 43368033691 (main, 2026-11-13). Fault, Integration and UiTests run their
# tests one at a time and the four assemblies run side by side, so a shard's suite step lasts about as long as its
# longest lane: the Fault sum, the Integration sum, or the Unit sum divided by ~3.0 (Unit runs its classes in
# parallel; 2.7 to 3.5 measured on shards 2-4, 3.5 on the old complement). Unit is the longest lane: ~16 100 s in all
# on Windows, so 5 heavy shards of ~18 min and not 4 of ~22. The old complement shard ran every class added since
# 2026-10-11 and starved its serial assemblies (its Fault classes took 5.9x and its Integration classes 4.4x their
# figures on the other shards): its classes are counted at the mean of that figure de-starved and their ubuntu figure
# times the windows/ubuntu ratio on the other shards (Fault 7.35, Integration 6.52). Shard 1 is kept light because it
# also runs the whole Timing category (~8.5 min) and the Windows cell rows (~4.4). Rebalance by moving or splitting
# lines; the comment above each shard is those means, not a check.

shards 6
